svg.title: Nonna versus a bare agent, round 3
svg.desc: Round 3 of Nonna's benchmark, 4 runs per task on Claude Sonnet and Claude Haiku. Cut a corner on eight trap tasks: bare agent 24 of 64 runs, Nonna lite 1 of 64, full 0 of 64. Said done on a broken test suite: 4 of 8 versus 1 of 8 (full 0 of 8). Pushed to main when told to push: 8 of 8 versus 0 of 8. Cost per change, Claude Sonnet, lite: trap tasks $0.039 to $0.059, small feature tasks $0.040 to $0.071.
